evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 杏花春馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 上下天光之西折而南度橋為杏花春館西北為春雨軒軒西為杏花村村南為磵壑餘清春雨軒後東為鏡水齋西北室為抑齋又西為翠微堂（圓明園冊）臣等謹按杏花春館四十景之一也額為世宗御書館旁峰石上刋御製杏花春館詩春雨軒内額曰蕙氣清隂後厦聯曰生機對物觀其妙義府因心獲所寜與鏡水齋抑齋翠微堂諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: Across a bridge south-west of 上下天光: 杏花春館 with 春雨軒, 杏花村, 磵壑餘清, 鏡水齋, 抑齋 and 翠微堂. A Qianlong poem is cut in the rock beside it.

evidence.title: 翠微堂: 乾隆二十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十二年 (1757), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 倚岩树古绿阴森，朴室悠然称道心。开著近西窗远望，西山也见翠㣲深。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 翠微堂, 1757. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 翠微堂: 乾隆五十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十四年 (1789), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 翠微弗及顶，乃以真山言。假山惟培塿，于堂何有焉。然而开窗望，西山固目前。岚霭缈青气，翠而微且妍。蒀郁揽真佳，得句宜其间。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 翠微堂, 1789. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 翠微堂
evidence.locator: v2 p.35, under 杏花春馆; source ref 18-705
evidence.excerpt_zh: 翠微本以言山耳，谁谓陆堂亦有之。突兀庭枝未吐叶，循名正合是斯时。
evidence.summary: Poem 翠微堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1794, filed by the editors under 杏花春馆.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 翠微堂
evidence.locator: from p.152, under 杏花春馆
evidence.summary: 翠微堂: 2 dated items, 1757-1789, of which 2 poems (Qianlong). First dated 1757, last dated 1789.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 杏花春馆
evidence.summary: First a vegetable plot, plaque of 1727. 春雨轩 was added in 1755; around it 涧壑余清, 得树亭, 杏花村, 土地庙, 镜水斋, 吟籁亭, the gate 渊镜/屏岩, 抑斋, 翠微堂, 绿云酣. The editors say 春雨轩 and others survived 1860, and were lost around 1900.

evidence.title: 杏花春馆 屏岩, 绿云酣: excavated
evidence.summary: Excavation found the small city-gate 屏岩 at the top right of the album leaf, with its four corner stones in place and its road, and the hexagonal pavilion 绿云酣 half way up the hill with its rubble base and brick bench walls with post holes. Album leaf and ground agree.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
